verdict.rationale: Claude Design is a design tool, so responsive frame behavior is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never mentions auto layout, constraints, or layout grids that resize designs responsively. The only related claim is generic layout controls to drag, resize, and align elements. That is an adjacent manual-editing feature, not responsive frame behavior.

support.subject: As a designer, frames can behave responsively — auto layout, constraints, and grids resize designs the way real UIs flex
